verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity ships common vesting templates and lets admins build their own (docs-26). Employees can track vesting schedules on their dashboard (docs-18), and the ASC 718 report breaks grants down to tranche level (docs-29), which implies vested/unvested tracking. However, the update FAQ says customers are being moved to other cap table providers such as J.P. Morgan and Pulley (docs-2, docs-3), which casts doubt on the equity product's continued availability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cliff configuration, milestone-based vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, explicit automatic vested-vs-unvested calculation for admins, independent hands-on corroboration, and clarity on whether the equity product remains available.
